title: Promising anti-leukemic effect of Zataria multiflora extract in combination with doxorubicin to combat acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells (Nalm-6) (in vitro and in silico).
authors: Lashkari, Mahla; Fatemi, Ahmad; Valandani, Hajar Mardani; Khalilabadi, Roohollah Mirzaee
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物与阿霉素联合抗白血病细胞，分子对接仅针对Bcl-2蛋白与小分子，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: One of the heterogeneous hematologic malignancies of the lymphocyte precursors is ALL. ALL has two incidence peaks that were determined in 2-5 years children and 60 years old adults. Cardiotoxicity of chemotherapeutic drugs is one of important side effects which may occur during or after chemotherapy period. The aim of this study was to evaluate the effect of ZME, Dox, and combinations on Nalm-6 cells. In this vein, the cell viability was assessed by Trypan blue and MTT assay. Evaluation of apoptosis was also analyzed by Annexin-V/PI staining. Moreover, the expression of Bax, Bcl-2, Bcl-xl, hTERT, c-Myc, P53, and P21 genes was detected by Real-Time PCR. Molecular docking as an in-silico method was performed for Bcl-2 and Bcl-xl proteins as well. Our achievements indicated that ZME had dose-dependent effect on Nalm-6 cells and ZME synergistically potentiated Dox effect. The expression of Bax, P53 and P21 genes increased although the expression of Bcl-2 genes decreased when cells treated with ZME/ Dox combination. Molecular docking showed the interactions of carvacrol and thymol in the active cavities of BCL2 and BCL-xl. Regarding to present study, ZME could be utilized as a combinatorial and potential drug for leukemic patients, which is under the treatment by Dox due to reducing the chemotherapy drug doses.
abstract_zh: ALL是淋巴细胞前体细胞的一种异质性血液恶性肿瘤。ALL有两个发病高峰，分别出现在2-5岁儿童和60岁成人中。化疗药物的心脏毒性是化疗期间或化疗后可能发生的重要副作用之一。本研究旨在评估ZME、Dox及其组合对Nalm-6细胞的影响。为此，通过台盼蓝和MTT法评估细胞活力，并通过Annexin-V/PI染色分析细胞凋亡。此外，采用实时PCR检测Bax、Bcl-2、Bcl-xl、hTERT、c-Myc、P53和P21基因的表达。同时，作为计算机模拟方法，对Bcl-2和Bcl-xl蛋白进行了分子对接。我们的结果表明，ZME对Nalm-6细胞具有剂量依赖性效应，且ZME协同增强了Dox的作用。当细胞经ZME/Dox联合处理时，Bax、P53和P21基因表达增加，而Bcl-2基因表达减少。分子对接显示香芹酚和百里香酚在BCL2和BCL-xl活性腔中的相互作用。根据本研究，ZME可作为白血病患者的联合潜在药物，在Dox治疗下，可减少化疗药物剂量。
